description: Keep only films whose replacement cost is strictly more than 20.99, so films costing exactly 20.99 are left out.

c.request: Taking 20.99 as the cutoff for a film being expensive to replace (`replacement_cost`), look only at the expensive films and group them by `rating`. For each rating, show the rating, the average `length` (ignoring missing values), and the average per film of `rental_rate` divided by `rental_duration` (ignoring missing values). Leave all values unrounded. Keep only films whose replacement cost is strictly more than 20.99, so films costing exactly 20.99 are left out.
c.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating
